name: Article 6 – § 1 – after point h – 59
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on enhancing police cooperation in relation to the prevention, detection and investigation of migrant smuggling and trafficking in human beings, and on enhancing Europol’s support to preventing and combating such crimes and amending Regulation (EU) 2016/794
part_text: (h a) recommending without delay to the Member States the administrative or judicial expulsion of third-country nationals involved in activities related to migrant smuggling or trafficking in human beings, where their involvement is demonstrated by substantiated evidence assessed in accordance with due process requirements of Member States;
